title: presets, with or without list, is an unknown command: the old word is not kept as an alias
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D6 and the no-alias row (the catalog commands are jitso build <subcommand>)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-10, build vocabulary; docs/decisions.md D6). `presets` and `presets list` are no longer commands: each exits 2 with `unknown command` and the word on stderr and nothing on stdout, like any other unknown word. The oracle still has the command: `presets list` prints the catalog and exits 0, and `presets` alone answers `not implemented yet` with exit 0, so the exit and stderr expectations FAIL on TS. The ts adapter maps only `build list` to `presets list`, never the other way, so these argv reach the oracle unchanged.
